reviews.title: I highly recommend this model
reviews.comment: This couple fans that I got work really well. They pull a lot of air to my case and they synchronize de RGB and speeds really well. They could get a bit noisy when you have multiple fans but it’s a normal sound. They are at a good point, great ventilation and cooling easy to install but the screws aren’t the best. I had to use bigger head screws. I think it’s a fair price

reviews.title: Coil whine
reviews.comment: Sounded good at first but has terrible coil whine. Don't make the mistake I did, spend the extra money for brands that are known for being quiet/silent if noise level is important to you.
